cases.author: Ben Kelly, LH Capital Group

cases.authorRole: Matt Hickerson, VP of Operations, Forge Origination
bullets: Before Spencer, Forge cold emailed one by one from their regular inboxes, so there was no real scale and no way to reach owners who weren't listed anywhere.
They needed a deal-sourcing engine to build targeted lists and reach owners at scale, so their team could focus on closing instead of running campaigns.
We ran six months: three months done-for-you building the infrastructure, lists, copy, and campaigns, then three months training Matt's team to run it in-house.
76,400 emails at a 5.01% reply rate produced 426 opportunities, three of which became Letters of Intent worth $900K in pipeline.
cases.description: Forge Origination is a buy-side brokerage that helps private equity firms find businesses to acquire against tight criteria, mostly in blue-collar service markets.
cases.quote: “Spencer really did a great job educating us and made it as painless as possible. In very short order we had three opportunities that came solely through the cold email infrastructure he set up.”

bullets: They had cold email working as a channel, until deliverability changes at Google and Microsoft broke it.

We rebuilt their outbound from the ground up, rewrote the copy, and split-tested offers until one clearly won.
Over the next 12 months the rebuilt system sent 261,000 emails at a 9.5% reply rate and produced 1,200 opportunities.
Their deliverability went from completely broken to better than it had ever been.
cases.description: LolaBird Fundraising helps schools, sports teams, and student groups run fundraising campaigns.
cases.modalQuote: “Spencer has been an instrumental part of our team over the past few months. The results of his work have been undeniable, and our email blasts have dramatically increased. We look forward to building a long-term partnership.”

sections.heading: Here's what happens when we run your outreach

sections.body:
If one of my cold emails is how you found this page, then you've already seen the system working.

Cold outreach is how we win our own clients, and it's the same playbook we'd run for you.

I spent six years building sales and email systems, including campaigns for brands like Coupa, Ford, and RMA Group.

Today we're a small team of go-to-market experts who help businesses build predictable revenue. Your campaign never gets handed to a junior or intern. I work on every one myself.

We go the extra mile because results are the only thing this business runs on. One client selling physical products B2B had cold outreach that produced 0 positive responses in 90 days. We turned it around to 1,200 opportunities over the next year, worth $1.8m in pipeline revenue.

For another client, a buy-side M&A firm, we generated 95 positive responses from business owners interested in selling. That led to 16 qualified conversations and eventually 2 purchase agreements worth $500k in fees.

Which is why we want to prove ourselves first. Your first campaign is a free test, and every interested reply is yours to keep.

sections.description: Worst case: we build your list, write your emails, run the whole campaign for free, and you keep all of it. Best case: next month’s revenue stops being a guess.
sections.heading: You’ve scrolled so far, at least claim your free test campaign!

faqs.answer: No catch, but there is a filter. A test campaign costs us real time and money, so we only run them for businesses we expect to win with: a proven offer, a customer worth $10,000 or more, and a target market of 100,000+ companies. That’s also why spots are limited to a handful each month. If the test works, we talk about continuing. If it doesn’t, you walk away with every reply and lead we generated, free.
faqs.question: What’s the catch with the free test campaign?

faqs.answer: Your campaign is live within 14 days of onboarding. The first few days go on your ICP session and list building, then the copy gets written while your sending infrastructure warms up. Almost all of that work happens on our side. You’ll know the send date before we start, and replies usually land within days of launch.
faqs.question: How quickly can you launch a campaign?

faqs.answer: We won’t promise a number before we’ve seen your market, because honest answers beat big ones. Results depend on your offer, your market size, and how fast your team picks up the replies. What we can show you: real campaigns have produced 95 interested replies in 30 days for one client, and 426 sales opportunities over six months for another. The free test exists so the number you trust is your own.
faqs.question: What results can I expect and how soon?

faqs.answer: Spam is irrelevance, and irrelevance is what the system filters out. People don’t complain when a recruiter calls about a great role, or an investor asks about their business, because the message fits them. Your campaigns work the same way: every company is qualified against your best clients first, and every message is written for the person reading it. One campaign held a 9.5% reply rate across 261,000 emails. People answer mail that’s about them.
faqs.question: Won’t cold outreach make us look like spammers?

faqs.answer: Ads bring whoever clicks. Outbound puts you in front of the exact companies you’d choose, because the list is built and qualified before the first email sends. That’s why outbound meetings tend to fit: everyone contacted already matched your best clients. If ads are working, keep them. Outbound runs alongside, and it’s how you land the named accounts your ads never seem to reach.
faqs.question: Why add cold outbound if I’m already running ads?

faqs.answer: We set up separate sending domains and inboxes for your campaigns, then warm them before any outreach goes out. Your main domain never sends a single cold email, so it never takes the reputation hit. Everything is registered for you, replies land in your inbox or CRM, and if you ever leave, the infrastructure is yours to take.
faqs.question: Do you use my email domain or provide new ones?

faqs.answer: An SDR runs $65K+ a year, takes about 90 days to ramp, and reaches prospects one at a time. The system reaches thousands to hundreds of thousands of qualified companies a month and hands the warm replies to whoever closes your deals. If you have reps, their calendars stay full instead of idle. If you don’t, you only ever talk to interested buyers. Either way, nobody on your payroll spends their day prospecting.
faqs.question: How is this different from hiring a sales development rep (SDR)?

faqs.answer: Very little on your end. We run the whole system, from research and list building through copywriting, sending, and day-to-day management. Your main job is responding to interested prospects and turning those conversations into customers. We’ll need some input during onboarding to understand your offer and ideal customers. After launch, the workload on your team is minimal.
faqs.question: How much work is this for my team?

faqs.answer:
We handle the entire outbound system:
Email infrastructure setup and maintenance
Prospect research and list building
Campaign strategy and copywriting
AI-powered personalization
Campaign management and ongoing testing
Deliverability monitoring

We can also build this same system inside your business, so your team runs it in-house from day one. That handover includes training and SOPs.
faqs.question: What exactly do you handle?

faqs.answer: Replies land in the inboxes we set up for your campaign, and your team picks up the conversation from there. If you want the leads in your CRM too, we’ll send lead and reply data there through a webhook. Interested prospects flow straight into your existing sales workflow. We provide the webhook and the data feed, but we don’t build or manage your CRM. That part sits with your CRM developer. Our job is generating qualified interest and getting the data where it needs to go.
faqs.question: How are interested replies delivered, and can you send them to my CRM?

faqs.answer: No contract and no minimum. After the free test it’s month to month, with no setup fee, and you can stop whenever you like. We keep it that way on purpose: if the results stop, you shouldn’t need a lawyer to leave. It also means we re-earn every client, every month, which is exactly the pressure a results business should be under.
faqs.question: Is there a contract or minimum commitment?

faqs.answer: Anywhere your buyers read email, outbound can work, so we’re not tied to one industry. The case studies on this page cover buy-side M&A, fundraising, and marketing agencies, and the same system carried all three. We’ve also run outbound in real estate, B2B SaaS, automotive, facilities services and maintenance, consulting, insurance, finance, solar, and sports. What matters more than industry is the size of your total addressable market and your offer having product market fit. The application checks exactly that, so you’ll know quickly either way.
